title: Modified scattering for semiclassical Bose-Fermi mixtures
summary: The Vlasov-Hartree system models a mixture of bosons and fermions interacting via Coulomb forces in which the bosons are described quantum-mechanically, while the fermions are described classically. For small initial data, we prove that the system exhibits modified scattering, i.e. the bosonic and fermionic subsystems each converge to solutions of the free Schrödinger and Vlasov equations respectively, but with coupled logarithmic corrections owing to the long-range nature of Coulomb interactions.
